minor.issue: Inbox items use key 'record_id' for the linked tour_id (no 'resource_id'/'resource_ref') — clients wiring to different modules must special-case per module. Consider a stable 'resource_id' alias for cross-module UIs.

action_items: Optional: add 'resource_id' alias on /api/admin/approval-inbox items so consumers don't need to know each module's key name (currently only 'record_id').

Optional: leave-settings enum is 'encash' (not 'in_cash') — the frontend segmented control label reads 'In Cash' — verify the wire value sent from the CL/PL Balance UI is 'encash' to avoid a silent 400 for users.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tours.py is 1039 lines and combines employee endpoints, admin endpoints, OD-attendance engine and expense-guard helper — consider splitting into tours_employee.py / tours_admin.py / tours_attendance.py per <700-line guideline.

post_tour_attendance() writes two attendance docs per OD day inside the awaiting loop without a transaction; a mid-loop failure would leave partial OD posts. Wrap the per-day insert-pair in a try/except with rollback of that day, or use bulk_write.

_cancel_tour_attendance iterates tour_attendance one-by-one and issues a delete_many per document — can be a single db.attendance.delete_many({'tour_id': t['tour_id'], 'source': 'official_tour'}) + tour_attendance.update_many for O(1) round-trips.

success_rate.frontend: 100% ESS flows tested; admin screens verified via API
